exit_band_20260806.classification: TRIM-BAND (+ FLAG: Q1 print UNGRADED, guide-cut probable at H1)

mode_b_finding_this_pass.headline: UNREAD PRINT: Q1 FY27 (Apr-Jun 2026) was published 2026-07-31 and is UNGRADED in the record. It was a collapse — and the thesis still survives it, for a reason worth writing down.
mode_b_finding_this_pass.guide_unchanged: FY2027.03 initial guide (15-May-2026) NOT revised at Q1: revenue Y84,000M (+10.0%), OP Y4,070M (+10.9%), ordinary Y4,380M, net Y3,060M, EPS Y242.4, DPS Y96. Q1 delivered 0.7% of the full-year OP guide.
mode_b_finding_this_pass.why_the_thesis_survives: The thesis was never an earnings bet. It is a BALANCE-SHEET-FUNDED dividend floor: DPS guided Y96 (ABOVE the Y88 verbatim-tanshin floor — the floor was RAISED, not cut), costing ~Y1,225M/yr against Y14,779M of cash (25.9% of total assets) and FY2026.03 free cash flow of Y7,717M = 6.3x the dividend. Equity ratio ROSE to 71.9% at Q1. A -94% operating quarter does not reach the payout.
mode_b_finding_this_pass.what-it-does-break: The +10.9% OP growth leg is now implausible; a downward revision (下方修正) at the H1 tanshin is the base case. That is an EARNINGS event, not a CARRY event — it belongs in alerts, not in a stop.
mode_b_finding_this_pass.honesty_read: CLEAN. The company printed a -94.4% OP quarter without dressing it and left the guide standing rather than pre-emptively cutting; the market took it ~-7%, correctly pricing the dividend as the load-bearing item. No takeaway-vs-data divergence.

valuation_anchors.note: BPS = equity Y38,255M / 12,765,820 sh (Q1 balance sheet).

rungs.anchor: 0.90x book (Y2,997) — forward yield compresses to 3.56%; the carry premium is ~gone

upside_trim_RESTING.why_the_rungs_sit_this_far_out: This is bounded CARRY, not appreciation. You do not trim a balance-sheet-covered 4.65% yield at 0.69x book into modest strength — you trim when the yield no longer pays for the risk. Both rungs are yield-defined, not momentum-defined.
upside_trim_RESTING.cancel_below_reason: 0.58x book. Below this the band was derived on stale facts; cancel and re-derive rather than let a stale limit sell a bounce.

exit_band_20260806.no_resting_stop: Confirmed. A stop here would donate a covered-yield asset into an earnings flush — the exact sell-side fills-on-the-cut trap §6 bars.

exit_band_20260806.doctrine: UPSIDE TRIMS rest as GTC SELL limits (fills-on-strength are wrong-side-safe). DOWNSIDE KILLS are ALERT-class only — never resting stops. Trims KEEP RESTING through scheduled events; they are catalyst-REVIEWED (forced re-derive), not pulled.
exit_band_20260806.tax_regime: All lots acquired Jul/Aug-2026 => SHORT-TERM until ~Jul-2027. Desk convention ST ~50% (fed 37% + NIIT 3.8% + CA 13.3% = ~54% all-in). A foreign trim realizes the USD gain INCLUDING the FX leg: basis is struck at trade-date FX, proceeds at fill-date FX.
